head: f1d3366ea8b1d4261fdf96c4267c5d331d5845a3
kind: Source trace plus observations in the original audited native643d run; no new execution
findings: Eligibility restoration deliberately creates a new chance. It adds no cooldown and does not identify a Schedule occurrence.
Skills start() refuses a concurrent run of the same skill; a waiting SayFrom does not queue another runner.
Coordinator takes a current offered store/item/delivery token only after idle, readiness, privacy, playback and quiet gates. Reminders::offer refuses while active or unadmitted settlement exists.
The current token remains stable across renewal. A completed durable ledger entry is known and recovered for acknowledgement without another spoken offer.

An interrupted attempt can be retried with exact retirement proof and a new correlation. Consumer settlement sets next_offer_us to now plus PACE_US (five seconds). This is an intentional retry, not an exactly-once guarantee for partial sound.
This does not suppress the computational cost of new chances after each eligibility flap; it bounds concurrent execution and separates delivery authority.
limits: No new test, product change, lamp or acoustic measurement. Existing native witnesses do not simulate every possible flapping timeline.
The wildcard skill ask is an opportunity; Voice selects the current occurrence. An interrupted partial delivery can be heard again under existing retry policy.
